summary: BRD-06 Column deletion guards: implemented DELETE /api/v1/boards/:boardId/columns/:columnId for removing empty columns with manager/owner authorization and OCC, protecting against final column deletion (400 FINAL_COLUMN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED), rejecting deletion of columns with active cards (409 COLUMN_HAS_ACTIVE_CARDS), rejecting deletion of columns with restorable trashed cards within the 24-hour restore window (409 COLUMN_HAS_RESTORABLE_CARDS), and atomically recompacting remaining column positions to 0..N-1. Audited and passed with weighted score 9.46/10.
